summary: Lays out a framework for delivering Internet Media Guides, which are collections of multimedia session descriptions written in SDP or a similar format. It describes a general model for delivery mechanisms, how existing protocols fit, and where new work is needed. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Like a TV guide for the Internet, listing what shows are on and how to tune in. This paper explains how such a guide could be handed out to everyone.

questions: what is an internet media guide
